title.narrative: Inclusive, Resilient, and Sustainable Housing for Urban Poor Sector Project in Tamil Nadu

description.narrative: The proposed project will promote access to inclusive, resilient, and sustainable housing and urban development in Tamil Nadu by supporting the state in (i) relocating vulnerable communities living in high-risk areas to safe shelter; (ii) providing affordable, proper housing for urban poor households, and migrant workers from the economically weaker section (EWS) and lower-income group (LIG); and (iii) supporting the state in regional development planning.

description.narrative: Access to inclusive and safe affordable housing infrastructure and services for vulnerable and disadvantaged communities in Tamil Nadu increased.

At least 6,000 economically weaker section (EWS) and lower income group (LIG) households allotted affordable housing units. Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: Signed allotment documents provided to EWS and LIG households (TNSCB, TNIFMC, and DTCP records) Actual value:

Housing unit occupancy rate of at least 60% in project-built affordable housing for EWS and LIG households Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: Beneficiary MIS annual report of TNSCB Actual value:

Total occupancy of project-built or renovated industrial housing and women's hostels for low-income migrant women and industrial workers increased by at least 4,400 Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Data Source: TNIFMC annual report Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Affordable housing for urban poor and migrant workers increased Indicator: At least 6,000 affordable housing units constructed in nine project sites with climate- and disaster-resilient and gender-responsive features, and provisions for basic urban services and amenities Progress/Status: On Track. 3,265 affordable housing units are under implementation in four project sites namely Vallam, Kalanivasal, Reddiarpatti and Pallipalayam with climate- and disaster-resilient and gender-responsive features, and provisions for basic urban services and amenities. Vallam subproject has been inaugurated on 23 Dec 2025 and Reddiarpatti is ready for inauguration. Physical progress in Kalanivasal is 99%. In Pallipalayam, superstructure works are in progress in 3 Blocks and substructure works are in progress in 5 Blocks.
Another 802 units under 2 subprojects (Greams road and Pumping station road) are in procurement process. Additional 1,250 units under 2 subprojects (Chengalpattu-Melakottaiyur and Kanceheepuram-Thirumudivakkam) are under finalization. Data Source: TNSCB housing unit inventory, GIS information, and survey (annual reports) Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 100 eligible staff from HUDD, TNSCB, and urban local bodies (including at least 80% of eligible women staff) reported awareness on good practices and lessons on urban poor housing O&M modalities, asset management, beneficiary data management, and ecological restoration Progress/Status: Not yet due. TNUHDB staff trained on these aspects. The trainings will be progressively expanded to HUDD and Urban Local Bodies staff. Data Source: Participants' feedback survey Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 50 eligible TNIFMC staff, investee special purpose vehicle staff, and O&M staff of private sector projects (including at least 80% of eligible women staff) reported awareness on good practices and lessons on O&M modalities, private sector engagement, and delivery of affordable housing for migrant EWS, LIG, and other vulnerable groups Progress/Status: Staff engaged for O&M of the working women hostels reported awareness on good practices and lessons on O&M modalities, private sector engagement, and delivery of affordable housing for migrant EWS, LIG, and other vulnerable groups. These would be also expanded to TNIFMC and other investee special purpose vehicles. Data Source: Participants' feedback survey Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Cleared waterways protected and ecological restoration is piloted in 2 sites Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Activity would be undertaken by TNUHDB in consultation with relevant land-owning departments. Bids for the package likely to be invited by Dec 2025 once the relocation process starts. Data Source: List of protected and rehabilitated waterways Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Future pipeline of affordable housing projects with private sector involvement for migrant EWS, LIG, and other vulnerable groups developed Progress/Status: TNSF has robust pipeline projects with the private sector involvement. 1,196 housing units are under construction under industrial housing subprojects at different locations in Tamil Nadu. Data Source: TA final reports Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Housing delivery methodologies and systems for the urban poor, including O&M modalities, asset management, beneficiary survey and data management, and ecological restoration alternatives, developed. Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Modalities are being developed in consultation with TNUHDB with the support of the consultants engaged under the TA. Data Source: TA progress and final reports Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Improved operation and maintenance schemes for safe gender-responsive shelter piloted in 5 housing sites by 2028 Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Modalities are being developed in consultation with TNUHDB. Data Source: Shelter design plans and asset maintenance system (annual reports) Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: O&M modalities and model contracts developed Progress/Status: Modalities and model contracts are being developed in consultation with TNUHDB with the support of consultancy firm engaged under the TA. Data Source: TA final reports Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: One model integrated regional plan for Tamil Nadu's industrial corridor (i.e., Chennai-Kanyakumari Industrial Corridor) that includes affordable housing, environmental management and disaster resilience, and gender mainstreaming formulated and submitted to the government for approval Progress/Status: Draft Regional Plan prepared. The finalization of the regional plan for Madurai region is in progress. A Project Review Committee has been formed. Project Review Committee reviewed the draft final report and committee observations to be carried out. Data Source: DTCP regional plans Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Tamil Nadu Shelter Fund total fund size increased to at least $200 million Progress/Status: Subprojects identified to ensure full commitment of the current fund size which is $92 million. Size of the current fund cannot be increased beyond $92 million. GOTN is likely to launch TNSF - II with a much bigger fund size ($200 - $250 million). Data Source: TNIFMC annual report Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Total bed capacity of industrial housing for low-income migrant workers increased by 5,000 Progress/Status: Total bed capacity of industrial housing is 39,627 of which 25,296 is operational and the remaining is under construction and scheduled to be completed in phases in 2026. Data Source: TNIFMC annual report Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Total bed capacity of women's hostel for low-income female migrant workers increased by 500 Progress/Status: Current bed capacity of the women's hostel is as at 1,748 beds which are operational and another 2,640 beds is in site mobilization stage. Data Source: TNIFMC annual report Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Two subsequent integrated regional plans for 30 Districts following the model in 3a completed Progress/Status: Regional Plans following the model in 3a for 30 districts are under preparation. Data Source: DTCP regional plans Actual value:

Output: Regional plan development supported Indicator: 60% of relocated vulnerable households registered in the graduation program in pilot locations (including 50% female registrants and all transgenders) Progress/Status: Not yet due. The target will be achieved after project completion. Graduation program commenced at two pilot sites. Data Source: Beneficiary management information system (semi-annual reports)
Actual value:
